newsitem.title: USA: Quest says diamond test results encouraging.
newsitem.headline: Quest says diamond test results encouraging.

text.p: Quest International Resources Corp said Monday preliminary findings from diamond testing on a portion of the samples from its Ice Property, located near Elkford, B.C., are encouraging.
To date, 25 tons of material have been tested and three clear gem quality fragments -- 0.185 carats, 0.045 carats and 0.02 carats, have been found -- the company said.

In October, a 30 ton bulk sample was taken from each of three kimberlite pipes and a five ton sample was taken from a kimberlite dyke exposed in a road cut, Quest said. A total of 95 tons of sample was shipped to Fort Collins, Colo., for diamond testing.

"These preliminary results are encouraging," said Quest International. "The testing of the remaining 70 tons will provide the additional data necessary to make decisions on the future plans for this property."
